article.title: THE FOURTH SCHEDULE
article.content: In section 142A, for the words, figures and brackets “and the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and the Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002 (54 of 2002)”, the words and figures “the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and the Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002 and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016” shall be substituted.
article.html:
The Fourth Schedule

(See section 248) · page 158 of the Act

Amendment to the Customs Act, 1962 (52 of 1962)
